subject: Re: Lasagna status: sweep week + readout framing
body:
Team,

Quick alignment now that the sweep week is underway.

Decision on scope, confirming what we discussed: decoder-focused sweep, 16 configs, both pairs — encoder mixing is formally deferred to a Q3 exploration if the readout lands adoption. I'll own writing that deferral into the readout so nobody reads it as a finding of "encoder mixing doesn't work."

Framing for Jun 12: if the sweep confirms the +0.4/+0.1 BLEU at 18% faster decode, the recommendation is staged adoption on pair A first (bigger quality delta, higher traffic), pair B follows once serving telemetry from A looks clean for two weeks. Milan's harness numbers become the before/after baseline of record.

Santiago — please confirm mid-week that all runs will clear the reservation window; if anything looks like it slips past Friday I want to know before it does, not after.

Dmitri
